items.contentSnippet: See how LSEG uses OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global business, accelerating insights, shrinking release cycles, and empowering 4,000 employees.

summaries.zh: 路透社集团（LSEG）利用OpenAI技术，在全球业务中推广可信人工智能，加速洞察生成，缩短发布周期，并赋能4000名员工。此举旨在通过数据驱动决策，提升效率与可靠性。
summaries.en: LSEG leverages OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global operations. The integration accelerates insights, reduces release cycles, and empowers 4,000 employees. The approach enhances efficiency and decision-making while maintaining reliability.

items.title: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex to build without limits
items.content: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate hard-to-reproduce issues, build across platforms, and focus on product outcomes.
items.contentSnippet: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate hard-to-reproduce issues, build across platforms, and focus on product outcomes.

summaries.en: Engineers at Nextdoor utilize Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate challenging, hard-to-reproduce issues, facilitate cross-platform development, and prioritize product outcomes. The technology aids in overcoming limitations and streamlining their engineering processes.

items.title: Industrial policy for the Intelligence Age
items.content: Explore our ambitious, people-first industrial policy ideas for the AI era—focused on expanding opportunity, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions as advanced intelligence evolves.
items.contentSnippet: Explore our ambitious, people-first industrial policy ideas for the AI era—focused on expanding opportunity, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions as advanced intelligence evolves.

summaries.zh: 本文探讨面向人工智能时代的雄心勃勃、以人为本的工业政策。政策旨在扩大机遇、共享繁荣，并构建适应高级智能发展的弹性机构。核心目标聚焦于人工智能时代的机遇拓展、利益共享及机构韧性建设。
summaries.en: The article outlines a people-first industrial policy for the AI era, emphasizing expansion of opportunity, shared prosperity, and the development of resilient institutions as advanced intelligence evolves. The policy aims to address the challenges and opportunities presented by artificial intelligence while prioritizing societal well-being.

items.title: Built to benefit everyone: our plan
items.content: A vision for the future of AI, focusing on access, safety, and shared prosperity as OpenAI works to ensure AGI benefits everyone.
items.contentSnippet: A vision for the future of AI, focusing on access, safety, and shared prosperity as OpenAI works to ensure AGI benefits everyone.

summaries.zh: 本文阐述了OpenAI对人工智能未来发展的愿景，强调以普及、安全、共享繁荣为核心，致力于确保通用人工智能（AGI）惠及所有人。OpenAI计划通过提升技术可及性、保障使用安全，推动人工智能的广泛利益分配。
summaries.en: OpenAI's plan outlines a vision for the future of AI, emphasizing access, safety, and shared prosperity to ensure the benefits of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) are available to all. The initiative aims to promote equitable AI development while prioritizing ethical considerations and widespread accessibility.

items.summary: 本文阐述了OpenAI对人工智能未来发展的愿景，强调以普及、安全、共享繁荣为核心，致力于确保通用人工智能（AGI）惠及所有人。OpenAI计划通过提升技术可及性、保障使用安全，推动人工智能的广泛利益分配。
